Their core product is a vector database that enables companies to deploy AI applications with high uptime, boasting a 99.95% uptime SLA. Recently, the company has been trusted by top startups and enterprises for their production AI applications, although no specific funding stage or team size is mentioned. With a focus on delivering high-quality technical support, Pinecone is well-positioned to support the growing demand for scalable AI solutions.
